name: Buffer writer
info:
Appends `msg.payload` (any JSON) as one JSONL line to a daily rotating file
under `/timeseries/{topic}/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`.

**Input** — set `msg.topic` to the buffer channel:
  - `cbox`     → `/timeseries/cbox/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` (silver: mapped Brick observations)
  - `unmapped` → `/timeseries/unmapped/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` (review queue)
  - `raw/<source>[/...]` → `/timeseries/raw/<source>/.../YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` (bronze: verbatim source payloads)
  - any other value → falls back to `/timeseries/misc/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`

Date is UTC (so files roll over at 00:00 UTC, matching cloud shipment windows).
Uses `file out` in append mode; each message = one line.
